Current Question Text: Date/timestamp for the first finalized Baseline Research or Home Mouthwash Collection
Notes: (11/9/23): New variable added; Revised (4/2/26): Update variable pre-fix from ‚ÄòBioFin’ to ‚ÄòBioCol’ to align with Secondary Source; (11/17/26): Updated notes: For both Research and Home MW collections, the date/timestamp stored in the Participants table will represent the first-finalized MW collection; For Research MW collections, this variable is a UTC-ISO formatted date/timestamp autogenerated via the Biospecimen Dashboard (Interpretation: If Site A enters Research MW collections at 2:00 PM EST on 11/4/26, the D/T will read as 2026-11-04T19:00:00.000Z and if Site B enters Research MW collections at 2:00 PM CST on 11/4/26, the D/T will read 2026-11-04T20:00:00.000Z); For Home MW collections, this variable is a manually-entered date/time entered into the BPTL dashboard from the Home MW Collection Card info. If the participant does not return the card or leaves the date or time blank, this variable will reflect the date/time that the packaged was shipped by the participant according to USPS data. The Home MW date/timestamp will reflect the local time for the participant (Interpretation: if Alice entered her mouthwash at 9:00 AM CT and Bob entered his mouthwash at 9:00 AM EST, they will both have stored values of 2026-06-02T09:00:00.000Z); Only home (not research) MW collections have a collected date that is timezone agnostic and will always reflect the ISO format of the local time when the mouthwash was collected; Analysts must also pull the type of collection (Research or Home) to correctly interpret whether the variable was auto- or manually-generated.
